description: This file is a JSON schema definition for the DTV API, representing interface definitions, methods, events, and data structures used by the DVB services plugin. It contains detailed definitions for tuning parameters, service info, DVB transport info, and notification events relevant to DVB service management.

methods.name: addLnb
methods.description: Add a new LNB to the database.

methods.name: addSatellite
methods.description: Add a new satellite to the database.

methods.name: startServiceSearch
methods.description: Starts a service search with specified tuning parameters and search type.

methods.name: finishServiceSearch
methods.description: Completes an ongoing service search, optionally saving the results.

methods.name: startPlaying
methods.description: Starts playback of a specified DVB service using its URI and optional LCN.

methods.name: stopPlaying
methods.description: Stops playback of a service using its play handle.
